symbols.name: first axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along the first axis of a two-dimensional array.
symbols.quote: For a two-dimensional array with axis lengths $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$, the first axis has $\ell_1$ positions and the second has $\ell_2$.

symbols.name: second axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along the second axis of a two-dimensional array.
symbols.quote: For a two-dimensional array with axis lengths $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$, the first axis has $\ell_1$ positions and the second has $\ell_2$.

relations.quote: An axis length is the number of positions along one coordinate axis of a multidimensional array, and it sets the length of the [Transform](transform.md) applied along that axis.
Each axis length is one factor in the [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) that gives the full transform.
